caption_L2L3: In 2014 the highest cost component/clinical phase for the clinical trial was clinical procedure total with approximately 480,000 US dollars spent. Cost per IRB approvals, cost of IRB amendments & patient retention costs are the lowest category’s. All below 10,000 US dollars.
